subject: Finovix MAP — SOC 2 evidence acceptance plan & security gate dates
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Julie Park <julie@finovix.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + MAP draft (SOC 2 milestone)

Julie — thanks again for taking the demo earlier. Quick recap and a proposed small-scope MAP milestone set focused on the SOC 2/security gate so we can keep the procurement timeline tight. Attached: a PDF MAP draft (v0.3) and the SOC2 questionnaire draft we typically share.

Key asks from our side:
- Can your security team confirm the evidence items on tab "Evidence Index" by EOD Wed 5/5? This lets us prioritize docs and publish the shared Drive folder with pre-signed access.
- Which of these items do you consider blockers vs. informational? We flagged "Data retention policy excerpts" and "KMS attestation" as potential blockers in the draft.
- Proposed target: Security acceptance sign-off by 5/12, DocuSign for SOW/Purchase by 5/19, production go/no-go 6/1. Is that aligned with your internal procurement cadence?

Milestone table (summary):
- 5/5: Finovix to confirm evidence list (owner: Finovix Security).
- 5/12: Redwood to provide missing artifacts + Security acceptance review (owner: Redwood/Finovix sec).
- 5/19: Contract sign (Procurement).

Dependencies:
- If KMS attestation is required from your HSM vendor, acceptance may slip 7–10 days.
- SOC 2 type-context: we can provide SOC 2 Type II report from our auditor (redacted) and control narratives; if you need raw logs we will coordinate SRE access requests.

Attachments: Finovix_MAP_v0.3.pdf (MAP draft), SOC2-questionnaire_v1.xlsx (questionnaire + evidence index).

Next step: please confirm by reply whether 5/5 evidence confirmation is feasible and who on your side will own it. Happy to jump on a short 20-min security sync if that helps.

—Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0183

Thanks Rafael — good demo and appreciate the clear milestones. Quick answers:

- I looped our security team (security@finovix.com). They'll take point on the evidence confirmation. They requested we flag two clarifications:
  * For "Data retention policy excerpts" — do you need the full policy or an executive excerpt plus retention table?
  * For KMS attestation — does Redwood accept a vendor attestation (e.g., AWS KMS compliance statement) or do you need our internal config screenshots?

- Dates: 5/5 is tight but we can aim to confirm the list by 5/7 if that is acceptable. Procurement target currently tracks to sign by 5/20 (one day later than your 5/19).

I think a 20-min sync on Thurs 5/6 with your SRE/Marissa would speed things up — we can go through the Evidence Index line-by-line. Security, can you confirm availability for 5/6 10:00 PT?

Best,
Julie
Julie Park
Finovix — Head of IT Programs
julie@finovix.com

Subject: RE: Post-demo recap + MAP draft (SOC 2 milestone)

Julie / Min — thanks for the quick replies. I'm Marissa (Security & Onboarding at Redwood) — Rafael looped me for the evidence flows.

Quick responses to your clarifications:
- Data retention: An executive excerpt + retention table is sufficient for initial acceptance; later we can provide the full policy under NDA if you need it for controls testing.
- KMS attestation: A vendor attestation (AWS/Azure KMS compliance statement) plus a screenshot of key policies from your side is acceptable. We do not require direct vendor contact for standard cloud KMS.

On the CSV export: I attached an "Evidence-Index-CSV" stub to this thread (we'll publish the full file to the shared Drive after you confirm owners). For acceptance, our checklist marks items as Blocker / Required / Informational. Blockers require explicit sign-off.

Availability: I can join Thu 5/6 at 10:00 PT for a 20-min call — Rafael, can you set the invite and include a short agenda (line-by-line Evidence Index review)?

Action items I own:
- 5/12: Deliver control narratives and redacted SOC 2 PDF (owner: Marissa).
- 5/12: Provide samples of logging retention policy excerpts (owner: Neha).

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Security & Onboarding Manager | Redwood Inference

- HubSpot deal: FINX-2027-0421 (I've updated the MAP card with milestone dates).
